style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the child lays a string of marigolds, roses and leaves: keys in the marigold's own golden-orange family, a contrasting berry Enter from the same garland world, butter soft keys, a very light cream panel

images.why: Student controls 'Object tray: holds flowers, leaves ...' and Description 'a pattern from everyday things': the marigold is one kind of thing laid along the string, told from the rose by its picture (Wrong: 'counts every flower as a marigold, writing six').
images.prompt: One single marigold flower head seen from above: a plump round bloom of many ruffled, overlapping petals in rich golden orange, with a slightly deeper orange heart. No stem.

images.why: Object tray 'holding marigolds, roses, leaves ...' and Wrong 'marigold, leaf, leaf, rose repeated three times': the rose is the second kind of flower, told from the marigold by its spiral of smooth petals (kept in the warm peach-cream family, never red).
images.prompt: One single rose bloom seen from above: smooth, tightly curled petals spiralling into the middle, in a saturated warm apricot-peach with deeper apricot-orange petal edges that stay clearly coloured all the way to the rim, and a soft golden heart. No stem.

images.why: Object tray 'holding ... leaves' and Observe 'a string of flowers and leaves': the leaf is the repeating filler between flowers in the string (kept warm golden-amber, as every skin is).
images.prompt: One single pointed oval leaf seen from above, in warm golden amber with a slightly darker brown stalk and fine veins branching from a centre rib.
